currentPhase.description: Learn-it v1.0.0 is the immutable promoted successor baseline with permanent release conditions. The independent reports on issues #88, #89, #90 and #91 are complete and consolidated. The CI maintenance lane from issue #85 remains active, accessibility work from issue #86 remains deferred, and product implementation remains on HOLD while the accountable owner arbitrates issue #95 and the governor prepares any later bounded authorization.

conditions: no migration of RC718 library, labels, sessions, progress or learner history
Safari is not claimed as tested
VoiceOver is not claimed as tested
slight TalkBack verbosity remains a known non-blocking reservation
human timings are not performance evidence

previousPromotedBaseline.candidate: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

mainRuleset.name: main-protection
mainRuleset.reason: GitHub UI reports that rulesets are not enforced on this private repository until it is moved to a GitHub Team organization account.

authorizedWork: preserve and reproduce the immutable Learn-it v1.0.0 released asset
execute CI-WP-001 from the exact released commit inside its four-path allowlist
retain the independent reports posted on issues #88, #89, #90 and #91 as read-only decision inputs
prepare GOV-WP-017 on a dedicated branch inside its two-path allowlist
retain current keyboard, NVDA, Android and TalkBack behavior as a non-regression constraint
preserve RC718 access separately without migration
conduct accountable-owner product arbitration through PROD-WP-002 issue #95
heldWork: all product implementation until the accountable owner records one decision on issue #95 and the governor creates bounded disjoint implementation, QA and integration work packages
merge of CI-WP-001 until independent QA reproduction and governor review
merge of GOV-WP-017 until independent governance review
ACC-WP-001 implementation and evidence work until formal governor reactivation
any change to the released v1.0.0 asset or its evidence chain
backend, accounts, cloud synchronization, catalog, commerce, institutional tenancy and marketplace
prohibitedWork: starting product implementation from discovery recommendations without accountable-owner arbitration and a new governor authorization
treating any discovery report or owner preference as merge or implementation authorization
modifying workflows, runtime, tests, authoring, kits, contracts or product documents from GOV-WP-017
allowing writable overlap between active lanes
changing the Learn-it v1.0.0 asset bytes, size, digest, tag or source commit
claiming Safari or VoiceOver validation without new evidence
using retained human timings as performance evidence
weakening existing keyboard, NVDA, Android or TalkBack behavior
migrating, interpreting or mutating RC718 learner data from the successor
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is configured but not enforced on this private personal-account repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The current verification harness applies integration-only topology expectations to ordinary maintenance and post-merge contexts.
activeRisks.closureGate: CI-WP-001 independently proves explicit verification modes without changing released product bytes

activeRisks.statement: The independent reports converge on a corrective-review problem, but no accountable-owner product option has yet been selected.
activeRisks.closureGate: the accountable owner records exactly one permitted decision on PROD-WP-002 issue #95

activeRisks.statement: Safari and VoiceOver remain untested and slight TalkBack verbosity remains a known reservation while ACC-WP-001 is deferred.
activeRisks.closureGate: reactivate ACC-WP-001 at a defined trigger and immediately on a blocking or major regression

activeRisks.statement: The clean break intentionally does not migrate RC718 learner data, which can cause perceived data loss without clear communication and preserved RC718 access.
activeRisks.closureGate: retain explicit rupture communication and separately retrievable RC718 access

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup, where GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove this exception only after the ruleset is enforced and a negative bypass test confirms the control.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Issue #95 must record exactly one accountable-owner decision from its permitted vocabulary. Product implementation remains on HOLD after that comment until the governor creates bounded disjoint implementation, QA and integration work packages.
nextMandatoryGate.parallelIndependentGate: The CI maintenance lane from issue #85 may proceed and be reviewed independently, but cannot merge before independent QA and governor review.

review.nextReviewTrigger: independent review of GOV-WP-017; CI result from issue #85; accountable-owner decision on issue #95; scope overlap; baseline or released-asset drift; accessibility regression; RC718 migration attempt; held-domain request
